defect: The new defaults 64 * 1073741824ul and 256 * 1073741824ul overflow a 32-bit unsigned long on Windows (LLP64), giving 0 and a build error/warning there.
reason: The ul literals were added by this change and the fix changes exactly them to ull for the Windows build, a supported platform.

defect: The new test fills already-constructed MutableCFOptions objects with special chars and frees them with delete[] on a MutableCFOptions* that was placement-new'ed into a char buffer, without destructors, which corrupts memory (UB).
reason: The memory corruption lies entirely in test lines added by this change and the fix rewrites exactly those lines to construct after filling and destroy/free correctly.

defect: VerifyIterator treats any PrepareValue() failure as divergence, so read fault injection makes the stress test report false verification failures.
reason: The PrepareValue check in VerifyIterator was added by this change and the fix removes it in favour of handling injected errors in TestIterateImpl; seeing it requires knowing the stress test injects read faults.

defect: This change only adds the iterator status to the error message printed when PrepareValue() fails.
reason: The false positive under fault injection comes from the PrepareValue check added earlier by ba164ac; this change did not introduce it.

defect: The new test's WriteManifest callback can also fire for a background flush/compaction LogAndApply after ingestion, replacing the snapshot with a newer one so the test assertions fail.
reason: The failing test was added by this change and the fix repairs it by disabling the sync point inside the callback; that background jobs hit the same sync point needs knowledge outside the diff.

defect: DumpTable never deletes the raw iterator returned by NewRangeTombstoneIterator, leaking it.
reason: The leaking lines were added by this change and the fix adds the missing delete; the New* naming and the unique_ptr wrapping of other iterators make it visible in the diff.

defect: This change only makes FullListIterator own (and free) its FullList.
reason: The SIGSEGV comes from GetIterator building the full list in the memtable's non-thread-safe arena, which predates this change.

defect: This change only replaces shared_ptr return types with raw pointers.
reason: The shared-arena SIGSEGV comes from new Bucket(compare_, arena_) in GetIterator, an unchanged context line that predates this change.

defect: prev_entries_idx_ = prev_entries_.size() - 1 implicitly narrows size_t to int32_t, which breaks the clang build with -Wshorten-64-to-32 as error.
reason: The line was added by this change and the fix adds exactly the static_cast to fix the clang build.

defect: This change adds a user_seek_target parameter to MultiScanUnexpectedSeekTarget and the MarkPreparedRangeExhausted helper.
reason: Starting the block search at the scan range start instead of max(start, cur_data_block_idx), which lets a multiscan move backward, already existed before this rewrite.

defect: The new const operator[] returns const_reference, following the same constness pattern as the existing operator* and operator->.
reason: The fix is a conformance cleanup of the iterator's constness, which predates this change, and no failure was reported.

defect: This change silences format-security warnings and switches the size test from a mock env to the default env.
reason: The leaked logger in CompositeRollByTimeAndSizeLogger fixed later is unchanged context that predates this change, which kept the existing deletes.

defect: The fix only replaces NULL with nullptr in the CompactRange call this change added.
reason: The real leaks the fix repairs are in ReduceDBLevelsCommand, which this change did not touch; NULL vs nullptr is style.

defect: This change only renames a local variable for the unity build.
reason: Applying the batch-wide max log number to every column family came from the MANIFEST group commit change, not from this rename.

defect: The fix moves SyncPoint DisableProcessing into the test fixture destructor.
reason: This change's test only loads dependencies and disables processing at its end; the ASAN error cannot be tied to its lines and the fix is test-harness hygiene that also touches a later test.

defect: The moved test checks FILTER tickers where INDEX tickers were meant.
reason: The typo already existed in db_test.cc and this change only moved the test into a new file.

defect: The fix makes ColumnFamilyOptions initialize and copy max_successive_merges instead of hard-coding 0.
reason: max_successive_merges did not exist at this change; the hard-coded 0 came with the later master merge into the column-family branch.

defect: The column family log number is set from the last batched edit (batch_edits.back()) instead of the maximum log number in the batch, and edits without a log number are stamped with the stale one.
reason: Before this change the code already set the log number from a single edit (the leader's) and stamped edits with the column family's log number, so using one edit instead of the batch maximum was already wrong.

defect: This change only turns a typedef into a using alias.
reason: The unity-build clash on the name CacheKey came from a later change that added another CacheKey type, not from this alias.

defect: The new ApproximateMemoryUsage test reads related memtable properties while background flushes (triggered by its 1000-byte write buffer) can run in between, so its equality and monotonicity assertions fail intermittently.
reason: The flaky test was added by this change and the fix makes it wait for or force flushes before reading the properties; the race is visible from the tiny write buffer and the separate property reads.

defect: The loop now compares a signed difference_type i with the unsigned vec.size(), which still trips -Werror=sign-compare.
reason: The signed loop variable was introduced by this change and the fix reverts it to size_t with an explicit cast for the comparison.

defect: SpecialSkipListFactory::CreateMemTableRep lacks override while the class's other virtual methods use it, which breaks the clang build (-Winconsistent-missing-override with -Werror).
reason: The method was added by this change and the fix adds exactly the missing override; the inconsistency is visible in the diff.

defect: SeekToFirst and SeekToLast build the search entry with offset 0 and no search key, so the comparator decodes the batch header as key '' and mis-positions the iterator with non-bytewise comparators.
reason: Both methods were added by this change and the fix replaces exactly those search entries with a kFlagMin sentinel; seeing it requires the comparator's handling of null search keys.

defect: The env returned by NewEncryptedEnv is wrapped in a NormalizingEnvWrapper that does not own its target, so it is leaked and the ASAN tests fail.
reason: The leaking test setup was added by this change and the fix gives the encrypted env its own unique_ptr; that EnvWrapper does not own its base needs env.h.

defect: The fix makes GetFromBatch treat kSingleDeleteRecord like a deletion.
reason: SingleDelete did not exist at this change; the missing case came from the later SingleDelete feature.

defect: The fix extends the test helper and tests for the later SingleDelete record type.
reason: This test-only change predates SingleDelete, so it introduced no defect the fix repairs.

defect: In the pre-C++17 branch, cf_key_map.emplace(key, seq) drops the TransactionKeyMapInfo(seq) wrapper, but that constructor is explicit, so the build breaks on standard libraries where pair's converting constructor needs an implicit conversion.
reason: The emplace line was changed by this change and the fix restores the explicit TransactionKeyMapInfo(seq); that the constructor is explicit is in transaction_util.h.

defect: The new retry_after_eof_ branch of ReadMore can return false without setting *error (when UnmarkEOF hits a read error), so ReadPhysicalRecord returns an uninitialized r.
reason: The new ReadMore branch and the new int r call site come from this change, and the fix initializes r at every call site; the missing *error assignment is visible in the diff.

defect: BlockFetcher stores read_options_ as a const reference, but callers pass temporary ReadOptions(), so the member dangles (stack-use-after-scope).
reason: The reference member was added by this new class and the fix makes it a copy; confirming it needs the callers that pass temporaries.

defect: InjectError stores the chosen error type in a local variable, while the new PrintFaultBacktrace prints ctx->type, which is never assigned or initialized.
reason: Both the local type and the print of ctx->type were added by this change, and the fix assigns ctx->type; the other false-alarm causes the fix addresses (direct IO, identical random bytes) predate this change.

defect: The test fixture's single shared DummyReadCallback is now mutated by SetSnapshot on every NewIterator call, which races when IteratorWithLocalStatistics creates iterators from several threads and changes the snapshot of iterators already created.
reason: SetSnapshot on the shared member was added by this change and the fix gives each iterator its own callback; the multithreaded caller is elsewhere in the file.

defect: VersionEdit parsed(); and VersionEdit edit(); declare functions (most vexing parse), so calling methods on them does not compile.
reason: This change replaced VersionEdit x(7) with the vexing-parse form and the fix drops the parentheses; it is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix adapts the test's MemTable construction to a new constructor taking Options.
reason: At this change MemTable took a MemTableRepFactory*, so factory.get() was correct; the build break came from the later constructor change in 055e6df.

defect: The new IncrementalBuffer test enables direct I/O in half of its attempts, which ROCKSDB_LITE does not support, so the test fails in LITE builds.
reason: The test was added by this change and the fix disables the direct I/O flag under ROCKSDB_LITE; that LITE lacks direct I/O is outside the diff.

defect: This change reorders member initializers and adds cache-line-aligned operator new/delete.
reason: high_pri_pool_ratio_ was already left uninitialized before SetCapacity used it; this change neither added nor removed that read.

defect: Pad computes the file checksum over buf_ from pad_start after the loop, but a Flush inside the loop resets the buffer, so the checksum covers the wrong bytes.
reason: The UpdateFileChecksum call over pad_start/actual_pad_bytes was added by this change, which the fix's own summary names as introducing the bug; the Flush in the loop is visible in the diff.

defect: The new assert(bg_compaction_scheduled_ == 0) in RunManualCompaction can fire when a waiting manual compaction wakes after manual_compaction_ is cleared but before the finishing background job decrements bg_compaction_scheduled_.
reason: The assertion was added by this change and the fix removes it; seeing the window needs BackgroundCallCompaction's ordering of the reset, decrement and signals.

defect: The fix makes the row cache store and return the record's own timestamp and extends the test.
reason: The wrong timestamp from the row cache was a pre-existing product bug (issue 7930) that this test change only documented with a commented-out assertion.

defect: MultiGet passes an uninitialized dummy_seq as out_seq to Get, which reads it (*out_seq == kMaxSequenceNumber), a use of an uninitialized value.
reason: Both functions were added by this change and the fix initializes dummy_seq; the read of *out_seq is in the same diff.

defect: GetColumnFamilyHandleUnlocked uses column_family_memtables_'s stateful Seek/current cache, which write threads modify without the mutex.
reason: The racy Seek on column_family_memtables_ predates this change, which only returned a fresh handle instead of the shared one.
